scene: The machine dispenses a dazzling soda, unlocking transport gates along the arcade.
picture: A flat side view along a glowing outdoor transit concourse. On the left, a light-rail pod idles with doors open. In the centre, a river hover ferry bobs beside the pier. Further right stands the boy holding a glowing soda can, his dance bag over his shoulder. On the right, a glass karaoke lift waits.
